explanation: No reportable patch-introduced defect was identified in the three reviewed Sigma files by source and existing-evidence review against the owning implementations and consuming-side dispatch. This is a scoped implementation verdict, not evidence of completed EE/EI production, a complete collision map, or a subsequent Dyson update.

scope.mode: Read-only source and existing-evidence review; only the requested review reports were written.
checks: All64 inner-h exchange sum and all128 independent forward/reverse electron callback legs
Greater, lesser, and theta(0)=1 retarded orientations
Contiguous and noncontiguous static row selection
No Gaussian substitution in the active EE contraction path
Committed-cell skipping, per-cell digests, bitmap authority, publication order, and crash recovery paths
A76 consuming-side routing and catalog layout

evidence_read.new_sources: Complete reviewed files and their new-file patches

source_review_conclusions: EE uses the owning generic operands, full64-h static/exchange algebra, and independent all128 forward/reverse callbacks. Greater/lesser operand orientations and retarded masking match the owners.
Selected direct outputs retain the full128-slot bubble. Contiguous and noncontiguous static-row selection preserves external-major/full64-h alignment across matrix and routed operands.

EI inverse routing associates each missing target with its original source and independently exported vertex legs. The active EE path does not use Gaussian U separation; the prescribed non-Gamma boson bath is retained through the owning history adapter.

Resume excludes committed scientific outputs, verifies committed per-cell digests, and rolls ahead-of-checkpoint bitmap bits back to authoritative checkpoint ownership. Commit publication orders numeric payload and digests before bitmap ownership and atomic checkpoint/directory fsync; a failed commit poisons further publication.
The A76 consumer processes the emitted EE/EI Sigma catalog layout and coverage; no unmatched dispatch or silently discarded output was identified.

existing_evidence_observations.selected_direct_oracle: At actual G1 q0 and ordered pair (19,7), both greater and lesser orientations report zero error for reordered/noncontiguous and tail outputs against A46 direct_q at rtol=1e-12, atol=0; wrong-row mutations were rejected.
existing_evidence_observations.descriptor_recovery: The helper deliberately reuses the owning streamed_material_state.authenticate parser. The recorded legacy string byte count and integer actual count describe identical original bytes/SHA; independent wrong-SHA and wrong-count mutations were rejected. This is not evidence of a re-pin.
existing_evidence_observations.corrected_production_status: Corrected EE002/EI001 were reported running at review time; that status is not numerical completion evidence.

evidence_limits_and_scoped_risks: The actual direct-selection oracle is narrow q0/pair(19,7) evidence, not full exchange, full EE/EI component, other-q, or crash-injection execution evidence.
Digest/bitmap ordering, committed-output exclusion, and crash paths were inspected in source; this review did not exercise them.
No tests, imports, builds, simulations, Native runs, source/data edits, or old-suite replays were performed. Source/report byte counts and SHA256 were obtained with coreutils only.
This verdict does not establish complete EE/EI production, all64-q collision-map completion, a next Dyson update with M2, accuracy, conservation, calibrated loss/rate, or closure.
